introduction.en: A Trie (pronounced 'try') is a tree-like data structure used to efficiently store and retrieve keys in a dataset of strings. It is also known as a Prefix Tree because it organizes words by their common prefixes, making prefix-based searches extremely fast.
introduction.hi: Trie (uchcharan 'try') ek tree jaisa data structure hai jo strings ke dataset mein keys ko efficiently store aur retrieve karne ke liye use hota hai. Ise Prefix Tree bhi kehte hain kyunki ye words ko unke common prefixes ke hisaab se organize karta hai, jisse prefix-based searches bahut fast ho jaati hain.

realLifeAnalogy.en: Think of a dictionary or phone book. Words starting with 'A' are grouped together, then within 'A', words starting with 'AP' are together, and so on. A Trie works exactly like this - it groups strings by their common prefixes, making it super fast to find all words starting with a given prefix!
realLifeAnalogy.hi: Dictionary ya phone book socho. 'A' se shuru hone wale saare words ek saath hain, phir 'A' ke andar 'AP' se shuru hone wale saath hain, aur aage bhi aise hi. Trie bilkul aise hi kaam karta hai - ye strings ko unke common prefixes ke hisaab se group karta hai, jisse kisi prefix se shuru hone wale saare words bahut jaldi mil jaate hain!

content.en:
A Trie is a special tree data structure where each node represents a single character. The path from the root to any node forms a prefix of one or more words.

**Key Concepts:**
- **Prefix Tree** - Each path from root represents a prefix
- **Node Structure** - Each node has up to 26 children (for lowercase English), a flag to mark end of word
- **Root** - Empty node, starting point of all words

**Applications:**
- Auto-complete and spell checkers
- IP routing (longest prefix matching)
- Dictionary and word games
- Search engines (prefix-based suggestions)
- DNA sequence matching
content.hi:
Trie ek special tree data structure hai jahan har node ek single character represent karta hai. Root se kisi bhi node tak ka path ek ya zyada words ka prefix banata hai.

**Key Concepts:**
- **Prefix Tree** - Root se har path ek prefix represent karta hai
- **Node Structure** - Har node ke 26 tak children ho sakte hain (lowercase English ke liye), aur ek flag hota hai word ke end mark karne ke liye
- **Root** - Empty node, saare words ka starting point

**Applications:**
- Auto-complete aur spell checkers
- IP routing (longest prefix matching)
- Dictionary aur word games
- Search engines (prefix-based suggestions)
- DNA sequence matching

keyPoints.en: Each node stores a character and links to up to 26 children
keyPoints.hi: Har node ek character store karta hai aur 26 tak children se link hota hai

keyPoints.en: Root node is always empty - it represents the starting point
keyPoints.hi: Root node hamesha empty hota hai - ye starting point represent karta hai

keyPoints.en: Space complexity is O(ALPHABET_SIZE * key_length * number_of_keys)
keyPoints.hi: Space complexity O(ALPHABET_SIZE * key_length * number_of_keys) hai

content.en:
A Trie supports four main operations:

1. **Insert** - Add a word character by character, creating new nodes as needed. Mark the last node as end of word.
2. **Search** - Traverse the trie character by character. Return true only if all characters exist AND the last node is marked as end of word.
3. **StartsWith (Prefix Search)** - Similar to search but returns true if the prefix path exists, regardless of end-of-word flag.
4. **Delete** - Remove a word carefully. Only delete nodes that are not part of other words. If a node has other children, just unmark the end-of-word flag.
content.hi:
Trie mein chaar main operations hote hain:

1. **Insert** - Word ko character by character add karo, zarurat padne pe naye nodes banao. Last node ko end of word mark karo.
2. **Search** - Trie mein character by character traverse karo. True tab hi return karo jab saare characters exist karein AUR last node end of word marked ho.
3. **StartsWith (Prefix Search)** - Search jaisa hai par true return karta hai agar prefix path exist karta hai, end-of-word flag se farak nahi padta.
4. **Delete** - Word ko dhyan se remove karo. Sirf wo nodes delete karo jo doosre words ka part nahi hain. Agar node ke doosre children hain to sirf end-of-word flag unmark karo.

keyPoints.en: Insert, Search, and StartsWith all take O(L) time where L is the word/prefix length
keyPoints.hi: Insert, Search, aur StartsWith teeno O(L) time lete hain jahan L word/prefix ki length hai

keyPoints.en: StartsWith is the key advantage of Trie over HashMap - no other data structure does prefix search this fast
keyPoints.hi: StartsWith Trie ka HashMap ke upar key advantage hai - koi aur data structure itni fast prefix search nahi karta

keyPoints.en: Delete must be done carefully to avoid breaking other stored words
keyPoints.hi: Delete dhyan se karna padta hai taaki doosre stored words na tootein

content.en:
One of the most powerful applications of a Trie is building an auto-complete system and performing wildcard-based word searches.

**Auto-Complete:**
- Navigate to the prefix node in the Trie
- Perform DFS/BFS from that node to collect all words with that prefix
- Return top suggestions (can be ranked by frequency)

**Wildcard Matching:**
- Use '.' to match any single character
- At each '.', explore all 26 children recursively
- Regular characters follow the normal trie traversal

These features make Tries essential in search engines, IDEs, and mobile keyboards.
content.hi:
Trie ka sabse powerful application hai auto-complete system banana aur wildcard-based word search karna.

**Auto-Complete:**
- Prefix node tak navigate karo Trie mein
- Us node se DFS/BFS karke saare words collect karo jo us prefix se shuru hote hain
- Top suggestions return karo (frequency se rank kar sakte ho)

**Wildcard Matching:**
- '.' use karo kisi bhi single character ko match karne ke liye
- Har '.' pe saare 26 children ko recursively explore karo
- Regular characters normal trie traversal follow karte hain

Ye features Tries ko search engines, IDEs, aur mobile keyboards mein essential banate hain.

keyPoints.en: Auto-complete uses DFS from the prefix node to find all matching words
keyPoints.hi: Auto-complete prefix node se DFS use karke saare matching words dhundhta hai

keyPoints.en: Wildcard search with '.' explores all children at that position - worst case O(26^L)
keyPoints.hi: Wildcard search '.' ke saath us position pe saare children explore karta hai - worst case O(26^L)

keyPoints.en: Tries are the backbone of search suggestions in Google, IDEs, and mobile keyboards
keyPoints.hi: Tries Google, IDEs, aur mobile keyboards mein search suggestions ki backbone hain

timeComplexity.autoComplete: O(L + N) where N is total characters in results
